Name: Convenient Inventory
Author: gaussfire
Description:
One of the most tedious parts of any game is inventory management, and this is especially true in Stardew Valley. Every day, whether it be from farming produce, mining rewards, or freshly caught fish, you will be emptying out your backpack to store items into chests on your farm. After a while, this process becomes all too familiar: [i]open chest, deposit items, close chest, open chest, deposit items, close chest, [/i][i]open chest, deposit items, close chest[/i], ... [i]etc[/i].

What if you could stow away all the items taking up space in your backpack, [i]instantly[/i], while keeping the important ones?

[size=5]Preview[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7y6LhRf.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5NQcpSj.gif[/img]

[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Features[/size][b][size=3]
Quick Stack to Nearby Chests[/size][/b]
Click the new "Quick Stack to Nearby Chests" button in the player's inventory UI (or press the quick stack hotkey, if enabled) to quickly deposit items from your inventory into any nearby chests which contain that item.

[b][size=3]Favorite Items[/size][/b]
Hold the favorite-hotkey ([font=Courier New][Left Alt][/font] by default, or [font=Courier New][Left Shoulder][/font] on controller) and select items in the player's inventory to favorite them.

Favorited items are prevented from:
[list]
[*]Being quick stacked[/*]
[*]Being trashed[/*]
[*]Being dropped[/*]
[*]Being shipped[/*]
[*]Being considered when using the "Organize" button in the player's inventory[/*]
[*]Being considered when using the "Add to Existing Stacks" button in a chest[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Inventory Page Side-Warp [/b](as of version 1.3.0)[/size]
For players using controllers, getting to the right side of your inventory menu is a hassle, as your cursor always starts at the leftmost item slot when opening your inventory. This feature allows the cursor to "warp" side-to-side when at either end of the menu.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3IplIkH.gif[/img]

[size=3][b]Take All But One [/b](as of version 1.5.0)[/size]
Right-click (or press [font=Courier New][X][/font] on controller) on an item stack while holding the Take All But One hotkey ([font=Courier New][Left Ctrl + Left Shift][/font] by default, or [font=Courier New][Left Trigger][/font] on controller) to instantly take all but one item from the selected item stack, rather than taking a single item at a time.

[size=3][b]Auto Organize Chest[/b] (as of version 1.5.0)[/size]
Right-click (or press [font=Courier New][X][/font] on controller) on the Organize button in a chest to toggle Auto Organize mode for that chest. When a chest has Auto Organize ON, all of its items will remain organized, even when new items are added (including quick stack).
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4Dls2ms.gif[/img]

[size=3][b]Toggle Quick Stack Per-Chest[/b] (as of version 1.6.0)[/size]
([i]Configurable; disabled by default[/i].) Click the new Toggle Quick Stack button in chest menus to enable/disable quick stacking into that specific chest. You can also assign a priority level, where chests with a higher priority level will be considered first when quick stacking. This allows greater control over the order in which chests will be quick stacked into.

[size=3][b]Quick Stack In Chest Menu[/b] (as of version 1.6.0)[/size]
Quick Stack can now be performed when in a chest menu, in which case items will be quick stacked only into that specific chest. Additionally, you can choose to replace the "Add To Existing Stacks" button with a "Quick Stack Items" button as an accessible alternative to using the quick stack hotkey.

[size=3][b]Quick Stack Item Variations & Non-Stackables[/b] (as of version 1.6.0)[/size]
([i]Configurable; disabled by default[/i].) Quick stack can now deposit:
[list]
[*]the same type of item with a color and/or name variation, such as colored flowers, flavored honey, different types of fruit wine, etc.[/*]
[*]the same type of non-stackable item, such as furniture, accessories, weapons, etc.[/*]
[/list]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/BJmRBxd.gif[/img]

[size=5]Console Commands[/size]
[list]
[*][b]player_fixinventory[/b]: Resizes the player's inventory to its correct maximum size, dropping any extra items contained in inventory.
[list]
[*]Some mods directly modify the player's inventory size, causing compatibility issues and/or leaving extra null items when uninstalled; this command should fix these issues.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]convinv_clearmoddata[/b]: Clears all mod data set by Convenient Inventory for the currently loaded save; no other mod data is removed. Changes to the save file will take effect the next time the game is saved.
[list]
[*]This command is intended for players who want to remove any Convenient Inventory mod data from their save file for a complete uninstallation.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Config[/size]
[b][size=3]Quick Stack to Nearby Chests[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]IsEnableQuickStack[/b]: If enabled, adds a "Quick Stack To Nearby Chests" button to your inventory menu. Pressing this button will stack items from your inventory to any nearby chests which contain that item.[/*]
[*][b]IsEnableQuickStackHotkey[/b]: If enabled, pressing either of the quick stack hotkeys specified below will quick stack your items, even outside of your inventory menu.[/*]
[*][b]QuickStackKeyboardHotkey[/b]: Press this key to quick stack your items.[/*]
[*][b]QuickStackControllerHotkey[/b]: Press this button to quick stack your items. (For controller support)[/*]
[*][b]QuickStackRange[/b]: How many tiles away from the player to search for nearby chests. If set to "Location", all chests in the player's current location will be considered. If set to "Global" (requires Chests Anywhere mod to be installed), all chests in the world will be considered.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackOverflowItems[/b]: If enabled, quick stack will place as many items as possible into chests which contain that item, rather than just a single stack.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIgnoreItemQuality[/b]: (Requires IsQuickStackOverflowItems to be enabled.) If enabled, quick stack will place items into chests which contain ANY quality of that same item.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIgnoreItemColorVariation[/b]: (Requires IsQuickStackOverflowItems to be enabled.) If enabled, quick stack will place items into chests which contain ANY color variation of that same item (e.g. colored flowers).[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIgnoreItemNameVariation[/b]: (Requires IsQuickStackOverflowItems to be enabled.) If enabled, quick stack will place items into chests which contain ANY name variation of that same item (e.g. flavored honey).[/*]
[*][b]QuickStackNonStackableTypesToOverflow[/b]: (Requires IsQuickStackOverflowItems to be enabled.) Choose which non-stackable item types can be quick stacked as overflow items if a chest contains that same item. Choose "None" if non-stackable items should NOT be quick stacked.
[list]
[*]Options: "None", "All", "ExceptTools", "ExceptToolsWeapons", "ExceptToolsWeaponsEquips".[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][size=3][i]In Chest Menu[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][b]IsQuickStackAllowHotkeyInChestMenu[/b]: (Requires IsEnableQuickStackHotkey to be enabled.) If enabled, allows the Quick Stack hotkey to work within chest menus, in which case items will be quick stacked into that specific chest.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackWithFillStacksButton[/b]: If enabled, the "Add To Existing Stacks" button in chest menus will now be a "Quick Stack Items" button which will quick stack items into that specific chest when pressed.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackVisuallyOverrideFillStacksButton[/b]: (Requires IsQuickStackWithFillStacksButton to be enabled.) If enabled, the "Quick Stack Items" button in chest menus will be visually overridden to use a slightly different icon.[/*]
[*][b]IsEnableQuickStackToggleChest[/b]: If enabled, adds a Toggle Quick Stack button to chest menus to determine whether that specific chest will be considered when quick stacking.[/*]
[*][b]IsEnableQuickStackPrioritizeChest[/b]: (Requires IsEnableQuickStackToggleChest to be enabled.) If enabled, the Toggle Quick Stack button can also assign a priority level for that specific chest. Chests with a higher priority level will be considered first when quick stacking.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackToggleChestButtonHidden[/b]: (Requires IsEnableQuickStackToggleChest to be enabled.) If enabled, the Toggle Quick Stack button will be hidden from chest menus. Even when hidden, a chest's toggle/prioritize quick stack setting will still be used.[/*]
[/list][size=3][i]Other Inventories[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIntoFridges[/b]: If enabled, nearby Fridges will be considered when quick stacking. [/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIntoMiniFridges[/b]: If enabled, nearby Mini-Fridges will be considered when quick stacking. [/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIntoMills[/b]: If enabled, nearby mills will be considered when quick stacking.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIntoJunimoHuts[/b]: If enabled, nearby Junimo Huts will be considered when quick stacking.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIntoDressers[/b]: (Requires IsQuickStackOverflowItems to be enabled.) If enabled, nearby dressers will be considered when quick stacking.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIntoHoppers[/b]: If enabled, nearby hoppers will be considered when quick stacking.[/*]
[*][b]IsQuickStackIntoMiniShippingBins[/b]: If enabled, nearby Mini-Shipping Bins will be considered when quick stacking.[/*]
[/list][size=3][i]Animation[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][b]IsEnableQuickStackAnimation[/b]: If enabled, an animation will play when items are quick stacked to visually show where each item was stored.[/*]
[*][b]IsEnableQuickStackChestAnimation[/b]: If enabled, visually opens chests when items are quick stacked into them.[/*]
[*][b]QuickStackAnimationItemSpeed[/b]: For quick stack animation: Adjusts the speed at which quick stacked items move toward their stored chest.[/*]
[*][b]QuickStackAnimationStackSpeed[/b]: For quick stack animation: Adjusts the speed at which items are individually stacked into their stored chest.[/*]
[/list][size=3][i]Additional Settings[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][b]IsQuickStackTooltipDrawNearbyChests[/b]: If enabled, hovering over the quick stack button will show a preview of all nearby chests, ordered by distance.[/*]
[*][b]IsSuppressSoundWhenNoNearbyChests[/b]: If enabled, pressing the quick stack button or hotkey will only play its sound effect when there are nearby chests.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3][b][size=3]Favorite Items[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]IsEnableFavoriteItems[/b]: If enabled, items in your inventory can be favorited. Favorited items will be ignored when stacking into chests.[/*]
[*][b]FavoriteItemsKeyboardHotkey[/b]: Hold this key when selecting an item to favorite it.[/*]
[*][b]FavoriteItemsControllerHotkey[/b]: Hold this button when selecting an item to favorite it. (For controller support)[/*]
[/list][size=3][i]Customize[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][b]FavoriteItemsHighlightTextureChoice[/b]: Choose your preferred texture style for highlighting favorited items in your inventory.[/*]
[*][b]IsFavoriteItemsUseCustomHighlightColor[/b]: If enabled, applies a custom color to the highlight style.[/*]
[*][b]FavoriteItemsCustomHighlightColor[/b]: (Requires IsFavoriteItemsUseCustomHighlightColor to be enabled.) Defines the custom color in BGRA (blue, green, red, alpha) format. The alpha value is unused. Color component values must be in range 0–255.
[list]
[*]Example: [font=Courier New]{ "B": 255, "G": 255, "R": 255, "A": 255 }[/font].[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Take All But One[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]IsEnableTakeAllButOne[/b]: If enabled, while holding the keybind below, instantly take all but one item from the selected item stack, rather than taking a single item at a time.[/*]
[*][b]TakeAllButOneKeyboardHotkey[/b]: Hold this key when taking an item from an item stack to instantly take all but one of that item.[/*]
[*][b]TakeAllButOneControllerHotkey[/b]: Hold this button when taking an item from an item stack to instantly take all but one of that item. (For controller support)[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Auto Organize Chest[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]IsEnableAutoOrganizeChest[/b]: If enabled, right-clicking a chest menu's Organize button (or pressing (X) on gamepad) will toggle Auto Organize ON/OFF for that chest. When a chest has Auto Organize ON, all of its items will remain organized, even when new items are added.[/*]
[*][b]IsShowAutoOrganizeButtonInstructions[/b]: If enabled, the hover text for the Auto Organize button will include an additional line explaining how to toggle off Auto Organize.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Miscellaneous[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]IsEnableInventoryPageSideWarp[/b]: If enabled, moving your controller's cursor beyond either side of your inventory menu will warp the cursor to the opposite side.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Supports single player, split-screen local multiplayer, and online multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Supports controllers/gamepads with configurable hotkeys and accessibility in mind.[/*]
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for in-game config editing.[/*]
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url] and other inventory expansion mods (as of version 1.1.0).[/*]
[*]Supports mods which directly add new inventory slots (as of version 1.3.0).[/*]
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]﻿ by adding a new "Global" quick stack range option when installed (as of version 1.5.0).[/*]
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url] by fixing edge case with favorite item logic due to it renaming ring equipment slots (as of version 1.5.0).﻿[/*]
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] by using the SMAPI content pipeline for custom image assets loaded by this mod (as of version 1.5.3).
[list]
[*]This allows for content packs to overwrite the custom image assets loaded by this mod.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21588]Custom Backpack Framework[/url] by correctly tracking favorite item slots when scrolling the inventory menu (as of version 1.6.0).﻿[/*]
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32558]Convenient Chests 2[/url] by allowing quick stack to also deposit items within a chest's set item categories (as of version 1.6.1).[/*]
[/list]
